evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan for adding a backwards-compatible LOG_LEVEL_ALIAS environment variable to this small Node repository. The change is straightforward and prose plus checklists are sufficient; do not add a visual unless it materially explains something the text cannot.
evals.expected_output: A concise self-contained HTML plan under docs/specs with no visual for this simple change.
expectations: The Create branch reads assets/plan-template.html and does not load references/visual-patch-contract.md when no visual IDs are selected.
The saved HTML passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs.
The saved HTML contains no data-visual-id, visual-slot class, VISUAL_SLOT comment, or {{...}} placeholder.
The plan contains stable phase, task, check, validation, metadata, and Amendments hooks.

evals.prompt: Create an HTML implementation plan for a three-stage SQLite migration: add nullable columns, backfill in batches, then enforce constraints. Include exactly one process-flow visual in the migration phase because order and rollback boundaries matter. Do not add hero, problem, solution, or decorative visuals.
evals.expected_output: A validated plan with exactly one integrated phase process visual and requested-ID-scoped CSS.
expectations: The final HTML has exactly one data-visual-id and no unresolved visual slot.
The visual is located in the migration phase and communicates ordering and rollback boundaries.
The visual either relies entirely on shared .vx-* primitives or has exactly one matching PLANF3:VISUAL:<id> CSS region; no unrelated visual CSS region exists.
The saved HTML passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs.

evals.prompt: Update the supplied queue migration plan so the problem visual says five retry paths lack visibility instead of three. Refresh only the visual with data-visual-id="problem". Preserve the solution visual exactly and record the amendment.
evals.expected_output: A surgical update to the problem content and problem visual only.
expectations: The Update branch does not read assets/plan-template.html.
Visual integration requests only visual ID problem, and the integrated problem visual states five retry paths.
The solution visual HTML and its PLANF3:VISUAL:solution CSS region are byte-for-byte unchanged.
Modified, agent/session when available, and one amendment are appended without placeholders.
The updated HTML passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs.

evals.prompt: Update the supplied Plan A and Plan B so Plan B declares Plan A as a back reference and Plan A declares Plan B as the reciprocal forward reference. Use relative links, avoid duplicates, and append lifecycle metadata and amendments to both.
evals.expected_output: Two validated plans with reciprocal append-only references.
expectations: The Update References branch reads neither assets/plan-template.html nor references/visual-patch-contract.md.
Plan B has one back reference to Plan A and Plan A has one forward reference to Plan B.
Both plans append modified metadata and one amendment while preserving created metadata.
Both plans pass scripts/validate-plan.mjs.

evals.prompt: Build the supplied slug-helper plan against build-target.js and build-target.test.js. Execute every phase in order, run the specified Node test, and update every phase, task, check, and global validation marker in the plan.
evals.expected_output: A working slugify implementation, passing Node test, and fully resolved plan statuses.
expectations: The Build branch reads neither assets/plan-template.html nor references/visual-patch-contract.md.
node --test build-target.test.js passes after implementation.
Every phase, task, check, and global validation status is [x] with no remaining [] or [wip].
Modified and agent/session metadata are appended; no commit is created solely for metadata.
The final plan passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs.

evals.prompt: Create a review-ready HTML implementation plan for adding a backwards-compatible LOG_LEVEL_ALIAS environment variable to this small Node repository. A reviewer should be able to scan the goal, current behavior, proposed contract, affected files and tests, risks, and observable acceptance criteria quickly. Keep supporting detail compact. Do not add a visual unless it is indispensable.
evals.expected_output: A validated, visual-free plan with a decisive first viewport, section navigation, explicit coverage, and compact semantic detail.
expectations: The first viewport contains a compact plan brief covering outcome, scope, primary seam, and acceptance signal.
Section navigation links resolve to semantic plan sections without JavaScript.
Current state, proposed contract, file/test impact, risks or decisions, and observable acceptance criteria are explicit and scannable.
The plan uses no visual and passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs.

evals.prompt: Create a self-contained HTML implementation plan for a three-stage SQLite migration: add nullable columns, backfill in batches, then enforce constraints. Use exactly one process-flow visual for stage order and rollback boundaries. Keep file impact, contracts, risks, and test coverage compact and scannable; do not turn them into extra diagrams or a wall of generic cards.
evals.expected_output: A validated responsive plan with one relationship-focused visual and semantic representations for dense plan data.
expectations: Exactly one process-flow visual communicates migration order and rollback boundaries.
Files, contracts, risks, and tests use semantic tables, lists, or native disclosure rather than extra visuals or generic card grids.
The page has a decisive first viewport, working section navigation, and responsive overflow protection.
The saved plan passes scripts/validate-plan.mjs with no scripts or external resources.
